entry: Stoch5/3/3 strict K,D<20 crossover or K,D>80 crossunder; immediate next 5m bar must close in signal direction; execute at following observed minute open
stop: extreme of signal, its two preceding bars, and confirmation bar; buffer 1.00 USDT; skip actual entry distance >8.00 USDT or <=0
cost_basis: entry notional, frozen project convention; no funding or additional slippage
control_match: same ETH, side, UTC calendar week and causal 5m TR20/close bucket, same confirmation and stop eligibility; one fixed random draw per event with replacement, excluding actual arrows
selection_metric: development serial total net points per 1 ETH; ties by lower closed-trade drawdown then policy name
time_boundary: Each segment is independently reset; positions still open at its right edge are censored, never use post-split prices to select. All is the sum of these segmented closed-trade results, not continuous account equity.
single_variable: Each arm changes exit policy only. Targets, BE, trailing and timeouts retain opposite-arrow safety exit; opposite_kd replaces arrow exit. Do not combine the winners.
execution: Closed 5m signals exit at next minute open; static stop active immediately. Break-even/trail changes use completed minute close and become active next minute. Same-minute old stop and target touch: stop first. Gaps fill at open. BE net uses max(trigger R, fee points) and tick-rounded fee-covering stop.
limitations: Historical data reused, not untouched validation or forward evidence
Drawings are winner-selected illustrations, not realized trades
Minute OHLC cannot reveal tick order; conservative rules and ambiguity counts retained
Fixed 8 USDT risk cap is price-level dependent
No account sizing or leverage optimization
